experiment_data.hypothesis: Frozen dt_emb (random init, no gradients) + learned gate WITHOUT curriculum (phase1=0, phase2=0, gate fully unlocked from step 0). Tests whether frozen dt_emb prevents CIVO (NVE < 1.5×) while allowing the gate to learn meaningful temporal abstraction (gate_dt_1_frac < 1.0). exp_022 was inconclusive because curriculum locked gate for the entire run; this rerun removes that confound.
